provenanceBoundary.supported: The root created a new subagent with forkTurns none, supplied the exact v2 prompt path, and retained the final JSON verbatim.
provenanceBoundary.unverified: No App Server transport transcript, tool-event stream, model identity, or machine-enforced read allowlist was retained. This is orchestration metadata, not transport-level proof of isolation.
